name: com.barakahprofits.app/halal-screen
title: Barakah Halal Stock Screen
description: Halal (Sharia) stock screen for US, ASX, Bursa and SGX stocks, with dated verdict changes.

tools.name: check_halal_stock
tools.description: Screen a listed company for Sharia compliance (AAOIFI-style): business activity, interest-bearing debt and cash under 30% of market cap, and interest income under 5% of revenue. Also returns the dates its verdict changed, from Barakah Profits' public verdict ledger. Covers US (NASDAQ, NYSE), Australia (ASX), Malaysia (Bursa) and Singapore (SGX). Pass a ticker (NVDA, CSL.AX, 1155.KL, D05.SI) or a company name.

ticker.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. AAPL, CSL.AX, Maybank

tools.name: recent_halal_verdict_changes
tools.description: Stocks whose halal screening verdict recently flipped (cleared or broke the screen), with dates. A dated public record most screeners don't show.
